title: stamp_contact_counters reads created_at_counter inside transaction after affected-rows check is already known
description: stamp_contact_counters() in contact.rs reads created_at_counter with a SELECT after the INSERT/UPDATE has already run (inside the same transaction). The SELECT is needed to distinguish the three sentinel cases (0 = fresh, <0 = pre-V8, >0 = existing). However, this could be combined with the upsert statement using RETURNING or a CTE in a future SQLite version that supports it, or simplified by reading created_at_counter in the upsert's ON CONFLICT clause. The current code is correct but requires an extra round-trip inside the transaction. For Phase 1 this is not a hot path. Document in a comment that the SELECT is intentional and cannot be avoided until SQLite supports RETURNING on upserts.
